parity_reason: No criterion's scores differ by more than 1 (A totals 30, B totals 31, a gap of 1), and neither image has a critical defect, so all three parity conditions hold.

reference.summary: Santa rides a green-and-black scooter over a snowy landscape at night, holding a stack of gifts, with a moon, snowflakes and motion lines; it is well drawn, apart from some messy overlapping around the gifts.

defects.what: a loose teal curved stroke floats across Santa's shoulder and does not belong to any recognisable object
defects.where: above the gift stack, at Santa's back shoulder
defects.expected: no stray strokes; any strap or ribbon is clearly attached to the sack or gifts it belongs to

defects.what: the stack of gifts overlaps Santa's body and arm in a confusing way, so it is unclear whether the gifts sit behind him, in his arm or on the deck
defects.where: the gift stack on Santa's back side
defects.expected: the gifts sit clearly in Santa's arm or on the scooter, with clean edges against his coat

defects.what: one trouser leg is a different, darker shade of red than the other, so the legs look mismatched
defects.expected: both trouser legs look like a matching pair, with any shading clearly reading as shadow

defects.what: the scooter's rear mudguard and the snow behind it leave a dark wedge-shaped gap under the deck that looks like a hole in the ground
defects.where: under the scooter deck, between the wheels
defects.expected: the snowy ground runs smoothly under the scooter, and the wheels rest on it

attempt.summary: Santa rides a blue kick scooter across a snowy hill at night, with a stack of presents behind him, a full moon and a readable 'Merry Christmas!' greeting; it is clear and pleasant, but the figure is simplified and a little stiff.

defects.what: Santa's body is a shapeless red blob, and his legs are thin black sticks that look like separate pieces rather than trousers attached to the body
defects.expected: Santa has a readable coat with a belt and proper trouser legs that come out of the coat and end in boots

defects.what: Santa's face looks straight at the viewer while his body and arm ride towards the right, so he does not seem to be looking where he is going
defects.expected: Santa's head is turned towards the direction of travel, or at least partly towards it

defects.what: a dark red strip runs down the side of the body behind the presents and does not read clearly as an arm or a sack strap
defects.where: left side of Santa's body, next to the presents
defects.expected: every shape on Santa's side reads clearly as an arm, a strap or part of the coat

defects.what: Santa's free hand is a small white dot sitting on the presents with no visible arm leading to it, so it is unclear whether he is holding them
defects.where: the hand next to the presents
defects.expected: Santa's free arm is clearly visible and holds or steadies the presents

defects.what: the scooter deck floats above the snow while the wheels sink partly into the hill
defects.where: the scooter's wheels and the snow
defects.expected: the wheels sit on top of the snowy ground and the deck rides evenly above it
